Name: Sulphur Farm
Author: Winterdrop
Description:
I've never modded before, let alone published something. I created this map for my own use but I figured more people may appreciate it as well! There's still a[i] LOT[/i] to do and improve - like, adding translations, change the worldmap image, and more. Maybe I'll do that when I'll gain more EXP points in map making... (҂◡̀_◡́)ᕤ
[size=1]It's a miracle already if something works...[/size]

═══════

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HTxrpPHG/features.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New farm type, [u]won't replace existing ones[/u]
[*]Glowing, animated lava and steam all over the farm
[*]Mountain items spawns, like vanilla mountain
[*]Super-small pond to refill your water can
[*][i]Some [/i]palms, immediately at Spring 1
[*]Thanks to the (very) warm place, grass can survive on winter
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/N67D7GgL/configs.png[/img]
[size=1](Either use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ or edit the config.json file in the mod folder)[/size]

[list]
[*][i]Force Summer Season[/i]: It's too hot for plants that can't handle the heat. You can grow only summer crops and trees. If you choose this when creating a new farm, you'll receive a more suitable starter gift. [i]DEFAULT: False[/i].
[*][i]Disable Critters[/i]: The temperature prevents critters to show up. [i]DEFAULT: False[/i].
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6JpWHw0t/requirements.png[/img]
[b][size=3]▹ Mandatory[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27117]Sharogg's Tilesheets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]Custom Farm Loader[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url]﻿ [size=1](for steam and light options)[/size]
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]▹ Optional/Suggested[/b][b]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url]﻿ [size=1](shouldn't be necessary in the first place but try it if your map looks inconsistent)[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/JRZqgfvd/installation.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install all the required mandatory mods first
[*]Download the mod and unzip it in StardewValley/Mods
[*]Run via SMAPI
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/n8bpPS5M/tba-maybe-maybe-not-idk.png[/img][/size][size=2]
[/size][list]
[*]Translations [size=1](I'll gladly accept your help <3)[/size]
[*]Compatibility with other recolors
[*]Fix the shrine location

[*]Can you catch fish in the lava...?
[*]Can ashes fall from the sky?[size=1] (extremely unlikely, but makes a lot of sense.)[/size]
[*][size=1]And can monsters be more greedy than birds?[/size]
[/list]
